Ýatla · Prototype Notes

  • Navigation (5): Home · Learning · Search · League · Profile. Premium remains reachable from Profile, but is not a bottom-navigation tab.
  • Home: Continue Learning, date-based streak calendar, actual weekday activity, six regenerating hearts, learning-focused daily missions, and a date-based Word of the Day without Share. League promotion/season information is omitted from Home.
  • Books: User-supplied Beginner and Elementary covers plus official Oxford covers for the remaining levels; correct CEFR labels and varied book poses. Device storage-size labels are hidden in Learning.
  • Account: Create account → choose email or +993 phone → local demo verification → username, gender, optional language-learning centre, and password entered twice.
  • Access & leagues: Free learners can study units and review Units 1–3. League progress unlocks after 3 completed reviews; entering mekan25 in the local Premium page shows all six league emblems in full colour.
  • Profile: Settings/theme under the upper-left gear; achievements, local avatar, and local friend search/follow remain available.
  • Local demo: No verification email/SMS is sent, and social features are not multi-user services. mekan25 is a browser-local prototype, not a verified subscription or payment.
  • Premium pricing: Duration choices and TMT amounts remain blank pending the owner’s price list; checkout is disabled.
